title: agentic-tools: add the pr-artifacts skill
brief: Every PR now carries evidence: the skill defines the before/after artifact contract, maps change types to a headline artifact, and ships a zero-dependency checker plus a CI gate.

blocks.title: What this adds
blocks.body: `pr-artifacts` makes evidence the definition of done for **every** PR, not only UI work. Install it with `npx agentic-tools install pr-artifacts`; it carries the contract, the before/after recipes per change type, the checker, and the CI gate.

blocks.caption: The enforcement loop: baseline before code, headline after, checked before review.
blocks.source:
flowchart LR A[Capture baseline
from base commit] --> B[Implement on branch] B --> C[Pick headline artifact] C --> D[Render recap + evidence] D --> E[PR body: Artifact section] E --> F{check-pr-artifact.mjs} F -- exit 0 --> G[Ready for review] F -- exit 1 --> C E --> H[CI pr-artifact gate]

rows: PR body: a diff link and "tested locally"
PR body: a non-empty `## Artifact` section showing the delta
Enforcement: checker + CI gate, identical for Codex, OpenCode, Claude Code
Backend evidence: a green test screenshot
Backend evidence: failing-to-passing capture, before/after payloads, benchmark tables
Artifact cost: ad-hoc, skipped under pressure
Artifact cost: one baseline worktree plus one headline block
